feeling_block.title: The feeling behind your journey
feeling_block.headline: THE FEELING: CONNECTED
feeling_block.intention: You want meaningful time together, built around coast days, memorable food, and shared exploration.
feeling_block.narrative: You and your partner get to slow into Cartagena with conversation-friendly walks through the historic center, then keep the connection going on calmer promenade stretches. Later, sea time on the water and an unhurried craft-beer tasting add shared moments to the art, history, and sunset coast views that round out the trip.
feeling_block.markdown:
**THE FEELING: CONNECTED**
You want meaningful time together, built around coast days, memorable food, and shared exploration. You and your partner get to slow into Cartagena with conversation-friendly walks through the historic center, then keep the connection going on calmer promenade stretches. Later, sea time on the water and an unhurried craft-beer tasting add shared moments to the art, history, and sunset coast views that round out the trip.

itinerary.packing_tips: Bring light breathable clothes for heat, a hat + sunscreen, and swimwear plus a small towel. For beach/water time, consider water shoes and a compact dry bag for electronics. Evenings can feel breezier—pack a light layer.
itinerary.travel_tips: Cartagena can be hot and some streets can be noisy in central areas; plan to move during earlier and later hours and use shaded pauses. For anything time-sensitive (tours, boat departures, sunset experiences), confirm details and meeting times with the operator. Also check current official entry requirements, local safety guidance, and any health advisories before travel.
